The '''breeding grounds''' were a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[F'tral]] where the world's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Iyra]], went to [[Reproduction/Legends|mate]]. Such meetings of Iyra from both [[Gender/Legends|sexes]] of a single caste occurred twice each local [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. The species's courtship behavior included virtuoso displays of [[Color/Legends|color]] changing by the males and [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] dances by the females. Couples attracted by such performances copulated, the male placing a specialized [[Limb/Legends|tentacle]] into the female and fertilizing the [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] inside her.<ref name="GG4a" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iyra breeding grounds were mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Troy Denning]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published in [[1989]].<ref name="GG4a" />
